mostWorthwhile.text: The close encounter was most worthwhile: the pair tightened as the single star gained enough motion to leave the cluster.

leastWorthwhile.text: Sweeping the gas outward was the least engaging moment on its own, though it set up the cloud encounter.

surprise.text: The escaping star heads toward the young system's outskirts without leaving the galaxy.
